concepts.title: Advanced Filtering Operators (where, in, contains, AND, OR)
concepts.shortDescription: Master range filters, text search, and logical operators.

theory.summary: Prisma provides expressive filter operators: comparison (gte, lte, gt, lt), lists (in, notIn), text (contains, startsWith, endsWith with mode: "insensitive"), and boolean logic (AND, OR, NOT).

targetHero.explanation: Combining price bounds, exact status, and case-insensitive search with AND.

explanation: mode: "insensitive": In PostgreSQL, translates to ILIKE for case-insensitive string matching.
AND / OR: Accepts an array of condition objects.
theory.keyTakeaway: Always use mode: "insensitive" for user-facing search inputs.

mcqs.question: In PostgreSQL, what SQL operator does "contains: "abc", mode: "insensitive"" generate?
mcqs.explanation: Prisma generates ILIKE with wildcards for case-insensitive partial string search.

concepts.title: Pagination Strategies (Offset vs Cursor-Based)
concepts.shortDescription: Compare skip/take offset pagination against cursor-based infinite scrolling.

theory.summary: Offset pagination (skip, take) is simple for page numbers ("Page 3"), but slow on deep pages because the database must scan and discard thousands of rows. Cursor pagination (cursor, take, skip: 1) jumps directly to an indexed record, delivering constant-time O(1) performance.

targetHero.explanation: Uses indexed ID cursor for scalable infinite scroll.

explanation: Offset: skip: (page - 1) * pageSize, take: pageSize. Fast for small tables; slow for deep offsets.
Cursor: cursor: { id: lastSeenId }, skip: 1, take: limit. Performs WHERE id > lastSeenId ORDER BY id LIMIT N. Extremely fast and resilient to new insertions.
theory.keyTakeaway: Use cursor pagination for real-time feeds and infinite scrolls to prevent database degradation.

mcqs.question: Why does "skip: 100000, take: 20" become slow on large database tables?
options: Prisma can only return 1,000 records at a time
The SQL database must read all 100,000 rows into memory before discarding them to return 20
mcqs.explanation: OFFSET N requires scanning and discarding N rows. Cursor pagination eliminates this by jumping directly to the index position.
